title: Tradition initiations
summary: How each Tradition welcomes a new apprentice.

claims.text: Many apprentices are inducted without noticing; some Verbena students learn they belong only at their first gathering, and Ecstatics let initiates find their own way.

The Chorus holds an investiture into its priesthood. Dreamspeaker rites run from a short talk with the spirits to days of vision quest, fasting, sweat lodge and scarring that set the initiate apart from the community.
Euthanatos initiation stresses the moral weight of their work, sometimes with a visit to the Underworld; Hermetic apprentices must pass a set test of endurance and social skill.

Etherites count a member as a full scientist when a creation or theory wins acceptance, for example a good review in Paradigma; Verbena use blood rites and scarring; Virtual Adepts must win the notice of the Elite with daring stunts.

title: How the Union recruits
summary: The Technocracy's own account of finding new operatives.

claims.text: Most recruits are Empowered scientists or operatives already in contact with the Union, spotted by sympathisers in institutes, schools, clubs and firms after a breakthrough.
Newly Empowered people who cling to superstition are approached to join, or handed to Psychological Operatives to be set right.
